epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce cycle time of stuck tasks in pending_review from current duration to < 1 day
epics.tocConstraintRef: Review phase blocked by stalled tasks
requirements: R1: Implement automated logic to transition tasks from pending_review to failed after multiple cycles

slices.title: Automate pending_review timeout logic
slices.jtbd: When implementing the timeout for pending_review for this epic, I want the system to detect and fail stuck tasks, so that the review phase bottleneck is alleviated
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task in pending_review for multiple cycles
When the scheduled check runs
Then the task status is updated to failed
Given a task recently moved to pending_review
When the scheduled check runs
Then the task status remains pending_review
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease stuck task count in pending_review by 100%
